text_block_list.text: —The day of the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Ruler, I'm truly glad we get to have a 
rematch like this.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: This time, I'm—in top shape as well.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ruler-san, I will definitely show you that 
I can do an even better job than you.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ruler-san, let's do this. All the 
frustration from not running well in 
Dubai— today's the day to make up for it!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is... truly impressive... Even 
when they stumble, they get back up and 
march forward without hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "And compared to that... look at meeeeee!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, you're right... This is no time to 
be stuck in a mud mire with a minus 30% 
terrain penalty.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Even just an inch—forward.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, 'sup. You're into like, board games 
or whatever, right? Are those actually 
fun?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah... If you're interested...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Kinda feels like it, kinda 
doesn't... I mean...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It looks tough in the first place, and I 
don't get it, so maybe I never will. Catch 
ya later!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey... what the heck...! Don't just 
bring it up and leave me hanging!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
There was a theory that gals are nice to 
hardcore gamers, but what a letdown. M-My 
motivation is...

There are 200 kinds of gals. One of the 
rivals, Tosen Jordan, was not the type to 
be particularly kind to gamers.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"To be discouraged by just this... I 
suppose my confidence still hasn't fully 
returned..."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, entering the Takarazuka Kinen... 
was it perhaps too premature...?
choice_data_list: That's not true. It really isn't!

text_block_list.text:
It brings back memories... of the past. 
The time when Rulership had completely 
lost all confidence.

Yes, that was back when we had just met, 
before we had even signed a contract.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
So in the end, punching with raw power is 
justice, huh? Haha, how embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I bet you think it's super lame too, don't 
you?! Fine, whatever! I'm quitting right 
nowwww!!

Stopped in her tracks by the high wall of 
Tracen Academy, she had completely lost 
her motivation. However—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I see. So you want to polish it from a 
strategic standpoint.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Taking into account the lineup, the 
course... and all the conditions, we 
should win as long as we're prepared to 
this extent. —What do you think?

"The breakthrough came from— shifting 
strategy not to 'win the actual race,' but 
to 'change the preparation.'"

Instead of charging into a wall head-on, 
look down from above and soar over it. 
That was the Rulership way.
choice_data_list:
Ruler, let's try to broaden your horizons 
a little more.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Field of view...?
choice_data_list: Yeah, look at the bigger picture.

Yeah, you have to look at the bigger 
picture.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I see... Expanding my tactical repertoire, 
huh? But what should I do...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(I'm fine when I'm enjoying myself from 
the bottom of my heart. But when things 
get tough... I'm fragile.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(How can I... constantly go toe-to-toe or 
even outperform those with unbreakable 
mental fortitude?)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I don't know. I really don't know, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ruler-senpaiii!! Do your beeest!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ――? That voice is...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"You can do it, Senpai! You can create the 
greatest masterpiece once again!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally expecting a shocking 
development and victory that'll blow 
everyone away!!

That voice was infused with tremendous 
energy. An energy that could never be 
found alone.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Heh... Fufu... Simple cheers, but still...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's working... surprisingly well... This 
voice...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Hooh.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I shall show you. It is not as if 
I stepped forward with an empty hand.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Even if my hands are trembling, I can at 
least play a card! Watch closely, Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, even if I'm battered and bruised, 
this stage is a sacred board to me.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
As long as we sit around that board— 
giving up is not an option.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"All that can be relied on now is the 
Trainer and the cheers from the crowd. 
However—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I'll make this my stepping stone. Toward 
the next... me.
